cues: Faraday's first law: the mass deposited is proportional to the charge passed, current times time.
His second law: the same charge deposits masses in the ratio of their equivalent weights.
In practice, one faraday deposits one gram equivalent, molar mass over n grams.
text: The same constant governs electrolysis. Faraday's first law: the mass deposited is proportional to the charge passed, current times time. His second law: the same charge deposits masses in the ratio of their equivalent weights. In practice, one faraday deposits one gram equivalent, molar mass over n grams.
